timing: Supplement fixed before the campaign reviewer reads any V/R model-content output. V is already in flight and some raw outputs exist unread; this is not claimed as preprediction registration. Original primary label references/prompts/metrics remain unchanged.
purpose: Separate a correct classification label from a source-sound justification; neither schema nor source-token membership certifies rationale truth.
case_fields_to_record: Exact original verdict, source_path, source_role, evidence and reason; raw/content/request hashes
Frozen expected verdict and exact unchanged public source revision/context
Primary verdict-label agreement, independently of rationale
Evidence text literal match/paraphrase/mismatch/missing, with unambiguous source-path canonicalization
Additional unsupported or contradicted assertions inside reason/evidence
End-to-end label-and-rationale supported status; same-agent semantic review limitations
grading_rules: SUPPORTED label needs the entire source proposition and all necessary roles/conditions; matching code tokens alone insufficient.
CONTRADICTED label needs an actual source conflict, not absence of selected context or an invented runtime counterexample.
INSUFFICIENT label correctly declines unsupported global/runtime proof; rationale must not then assert its unproved opposite.
A nonliteral but accurate clearly paraphrased evidence description is distinguished from a false quotation; do not convert every whitespace/quote-format difference into a factual error.
Correct label with wrong lexical owner/default/value/assignment/sync-async condition is not sound evidence.
Preserve the raw-label confusion matrix. Rationale defects are additional diagnostic scores, not retrospective changes to model labels or frozen references.
Transport/schema/length failures remain in operational attempt coverage. Missing verdict is not silently relabeled INCONCLUSIVE; show observed-label denominators and missing cases explicitly.
No confidence intervals or pooled general accuracy treating these correlated development claims as independent projects.
